description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended pembrolizumab, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating high MSI or MMR deficient unresectable or metastatic gastric, small intestine or biliary cancer in adults that has progressed during or after 1 therapy. Pembrolizumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS, stopped at 2 years of uninterrupted treatment or earlier if the cancer progresses.
